source: Built from orbital-cli behaviors_vectors.rs lookup_with_model and user_store_path (model choice, snapshot-then-user layering, miss dedup, batches of 64, ORB_VECTOR_PROVIDER_MISSING message with the first 5 keys, ORB_VECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH message, store file slug). The store and provider answers are stubbed by feeding VECTOR_RESOLVED, USER_STORE_READ, LLM_EMBED_RESULT and LLM_FAILED; nothing reaches a network. Each internal event replays as its own step.
